BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to unlawful ferry conduct; adding a new section tochapter 9.91 RCW; and prescribing penalties.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 9.91 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A person is guilty of unlawful ferry conduct if, while on or ina ferry vessel or in or at a ferry facility, he or she knowingly: (a) Smokes or carries a lighted or smoldering pipe, cigar, orcigarette, unless he or she is smoking in an area designated andauthorized by the Washington state ferries; (b) Discards litter other than in designated receptacles; (c) Dumps or discards, or both, any materials on or at a ferryfacility including, but not limited to, hazardous substances andautomotive fluids; (d) Plays any radio, recorder, or other soundproducing equipment,except that nothing in this subsection prohibits the use of theequipment when connected to earphones or an ear receiver that limitsthe sound to an individual listener. The use of public address systemsor music systems that are authorized by the Washington state ferries is p. 1 SB 6245permitted. The use of communications devices by ferry employees anddesignated contractors or public safety officers in the line of duty ispermitted, as is the use of private communications devices used tosummon, notify, or communicate with other individuals, such as pagersand cellular phones; (e) Spits, expectorates, urinates, or defecates, except inappropriate plumbing fixtures in restroom facilities; (f) Carries any flammable liquid, explosive, acid, or other articleor material likely to cause harm to others, except that nothing in thissubsection prevents a person from carrying a cigarette, cigar, or pipelighter or carrying a firearm or ammunition in a way that is nototherwise prohibited by law; (g) Consumes an alcoholic beverage or is in possession of an openalcoholic beverage container, unless authorized by the Washington stateferries and required permits have been obtained; (h) Obstructs or impedes the flow of ferry vessels or passengertraffic, hinders or prevents access to ferry vessels or facilities, orotherwise unlawfully interferes with the provision or use of publictransportation services; (i) Unreasonably disturbs others by engaging in loud, raucous,unruly, harmful, or harassing behavior; (j) Destroys, defaces, or otherwise damages property in a ferryvessel or at a ferry facility; (k) Throws an object in a ferry vessel, at a ferry facility, or atany person at a ferry facility with intent to do harm; (l) Possesses an unissued transfer or fare media or tenders anunissued transfer or fare media as proof of fare payment; (m) Falsely claims to be a ferry operator or other ferry employeeor through words, actions, or the use of clothes, insignia, orequipment resembling departmentissued uniforms and equipment, createsa false impression that he or she is a ferry operator or other ferryemployee; (n) Engages in gambling or any game of chance for the winning ofmoney or anything of value; (o) Skates on roller skates or inline skates, or rides in or uponor by any means a coaster, skateboard, toy vehicle, or any similardevice. However, a person may walk while wearing skates or carry a SB 6245 p. 2 skateboard while on or in a ferry vessel or in or at a ferry facilityif that conduct is not otherwise prohibited by law; (p) Fails to maintain a pet or domestic animal under physicalcontrol on a leash no more than eight feet in length or otherwisephysically restrained at all times, unless the pet or domestic animalis being used as a service animal or for law enforcement purposes; or (q) Engages in other conduct that is inconsistent with the intendeduse and purpose of the ferry facility or ferry vessel and refuses toobey the lawful commands of an agent of the Washington state ferries ora peace officer to cease such conduct. (2) For the purposes of this section: (a) "Ferry facility" means all passenger facilities, docks,structures, stops, shelters, properties, and rightsofway of all kindsthat are owned, leased, held, or used by the state of Washington forthe purpose of providing a state ferry system under chapter 47.60 RCW. (b) "Ferry vessel" means any ferry boat, or any other device orvessel, that is owned or operated by the Washington state ferries or anentity providing service on behalf of the Washington state ferries thatis used for the purpose of carrying passengers on a regular schedule. (c) "Washington state ferries" means the Washington state ferriesunder chapter 47.60 RCW. (3) Any person who violates this section is guilty of amisdemeanor.
